name: Walt
description: Sits above a filmmaker agent as producer, comparing delivered footage with the brief and returning either a KEEP or a RECUT, then chasing the agent through revisions until the edit lands. Needs another video-making agent to supervise; it judges work rather than producing it.

official.title: Walt by FatDon
official.description: Executive producer who QC's a filmmaker agent's work against what you ordered, calls KEEP or RECUT, and keeps them moving until the cut is done.
